title: Glowing castle
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='glow' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd76a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e8752b'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='wall' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#9fb8d8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#5f7fa8'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='roof' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#e05a8a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#a83a6a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id='halo' cx='0.5' cy='0.5' r='0.5'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe89a' stop-opacity='0.65'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffe89a' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- glow halo behind castle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='46' ry='40' fill='url(#halo)'/>

  <!-- ground -->
  <rect x='8' y='84' width='84' height='8' rx='3' fill='#3f6b4f'/>
  <rect x='8' y='84' width='84' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#5e9670'/>

  <!-- main keep wall -->
  <rect x='32' y='46' width='36' height='38' fill='url(#wall)'/>
  <rect x='32' y='46' width='36' height='4' fill='#b6cbe6'/>

  <!-- keep crenellations -->
  <rect x='32' y='40' width='7' height='8' fill='url(#wall)'/>
  <rect x='46.5' y='40' width='7' height='8' fill='url(#wall)'/>
  <rect x='61' y='40' width='7' height='8' fill='url(#wall)'/>
  <rect x='32' y='40' width='36' height='3' fill='#b6cbe6'/>

  <!-- keep roof -->
  <polygon points='50,22 34,40 66,40' fill='url(#roof)'/>
  <polygon points='50,22 44,38 56,38' fill='#f07aa4' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='20' r='2.6' fill='#ffe07a'/>

  <!-- left tower -->
  <rect x='16' y='54' width='16' height='30' fill='url(#wall)'/>
  <rect x='16' y='54' width='16' height='3.5' fill='#b6cbe6'/>
  <polygon points='24,34 14,54 34,54' fill='url(#roof)'/>
  <polygon points='24,34 20,52 28,52' fill='#f07aa4' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='32' r='2.2' fill='#ffe07a'/>

  <!-- right tower -->
  <rect x='68' y='54' width='16' height='30' fill='url(#wall)'/>
  <rect x='68' y='54' width='16' height='3.5' fill='#b6cbe6'/>
  <polygon points='76,34 66,54 86,54' fill='url(#roof)'/>
  <polygon points='76,34 72,52 80,52' fill='#f07aa4' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='32' r='2.2' fill='#ffe07a'/>

  <!-- glowing windows -->
  <rect x='37' y='54' width='7' height='10' rx='3.5' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <rect x='56' y='54' width='7' height='10' rx='3.5' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <rect x='21' y='60' width='6' height='9' rx='3' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <rect x='73' y='60' width='6' height='9' rx='3' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- keep door glowing -->
  <path d='M44 84 L44 72 Q50 64 56 72 L56 84 Z' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='72' x2='50' y2='84' stroke='#c25a1e' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='78' r='1.1' fill='#c25a1e'/>

  <!-- soft sparkles -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='30' r='1.6' fill='#fff1b0'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='26' r='1.4' fill='#fff1b0'/>
  <circle cx='14' cy='42' r='1.2' fill='#fff1b0'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='44' r='1.3' fill='#fff1b0'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='14' r='1.5' fill='#fff1b0'/>
</svg>
